title: POS buttons and layout (preview)
description: Checkout App POS menu layout. Defines menu trees per application type, mode and function

menuTrees.description: Menu lists available to the Checkout App. Each list is a hierarchy of groups and items.

id.title: Condition
id.description: Undocumented values can be ignored by the client. There is no expectation on clients to handle conditions until they are described in the API.

oneOf.title: Active transaction
oneOf.description: An active transaction must exist.

oneOf.title: No active transaction
oneOf.description: A transaction should not be active. If a transaction already exists, the operation will fail if invoked.

oneOf.title: Line selected
oneOf.description: The operation requires an entity to be selected and passed as input. The selected entity should be passed as a parameter. If set, this implies that the HAS_TRANSACTION condition is fulfilled.

oneOf.title: Loyalty present
oneOf.description: The loyalty information should be present in the transaction. If loyalty is not present, the operation will fail if invoked.

oneOf.title: No loyalty
oneOf.description: No loyalty information should be present in the transaction. If loyalty is present, the operation will fail if invoked.

oneOf.title: No tender
oneOf.description: No tender (payment) information should be present in the transaction. If the transaction is partially paid, the operation will fail if invoked.

oneOf.title: Has items
oneOf.description: Active (non-voided) items should be present in the transaction. If no items present in the transaction, the operation will fail if invoked.

deleted.title: Deleted
deleted.description: If true, this condition will be ignored

MenuItemAction.title: Action
MenuItemAction.description: The action to perform when the Menu item is selected. Catalogue actions pick a category and type. Custom commands set category command plus the Checkout Engine command name.

oneOf.title: Sale functions
oneOf.description: Sale, refund, price, customer, cash drawer and gift-card functions.

oneOf.title: Suspend order
oneOf.description: Parks the current sale so it can be finished later. Aliases to SuspendOrderCommand. An active transaction must exist.

oneOf.title: Retrieve suspended order
oneOf.description: Brings back a parked sale so the cashier can continue. Aliases to ResumeOrderCommand. A transaction should not be active.

oneOf.title: Cancel order
oneOf.description: Cancels the current sale. Nothing is kept to resume later. Aliases to CancelOrderCommand. An active transaction must exist.

oneOf.title: Void selected line
oneOf.description: Voids the selected receipt line so it no longer counts toward the total. Aliases to VoidModeKeyCommand. A receipt line must be selected.

oneOf.title: Change quantity
oneOf.description: Changes the quantity of the selected receipt line. Aliases to QuantityKeyCommand. A receipt line must be selected.

oneOf.title: Receipt comment
oneOf.description: Adds a comment to the whole receipt. Aliases to ReceiptCommentCommand. An active transaction must exist.

oneOf.title: Comment on line
oneOf.description: Adds a comment to the selected receipt line. Aliases to ReceiptCommentLineCommand. A receipt line must be selected.

oneOf.title: Return without receipt
oneOf.description: Puts the till into refund mode so the next item is refunded without looking up an original receipt. Aliases to RefundModeKeyCommand.

oneOf.title: Complaint
oneOf.description: Puts the till into complaint mode so the next item is treated as a complaint without looking up an original receipt. Aliases to ComplaintModeKeyCommand.

oneOf.title: Refund previous order
oneOf.description: Looks up a previous receipt and starts a refund against that sale. Aliases to RefundPreviousOrderCommand.

oneOf.title: Complaint previous order
oneOf.description: Looks up a previous receipt and starts a complaint against that sale. Aliases to ComplaintPreviousOrderCommand.

oneOf.title: Exit refund previous order
oneOf.description: Completes a refund of a previous receipt so the cashier can pay it out. Aliases to ExitRefundPreviousOrderCommand. An active transaction must exist.

oneOf.title: Cancel refund previous order
oneOf.description: Abandons a refund of a previous receipt without completing it. Aliases to CancelRefundPreviousOrderCommand.

oneOf.title: Refund selected line
oneOf.description: Refunds the selected line while returning items from a previous receipt. Aliases to RefundElementCommand. A receipt line must be selected.

oneOf.title: Print receipt copy
oneOf.description: Prints a copy of a completed receipt. Aliases to PrintCopyCommand.

oneOf.title: Print gift receipt
oneOf.description: Requests a gift receipt for the current sale. Aliases to PrintGiftReceiptCommand. An active transaction must exist.

oneOf.title: VAT invoice
oneOf.description: Marks that the customer wants a VAT invoice when the sale is completed. Aliases to RequestVatInvoiceIssueCommand. An active transaction must exist.

oneOf.title: Extended receipt
oneOf.description: Collects extra customer details onto the receipt, such as name or organisation number. Aliases to ExtendedReceiptCommand. An active transaction must exist.

oneOf.title: Toggle refund-only mode
oneOf.description: Switches the till between normal selling and refund-only mode. Aliases to ToggleRefundOnlyCommand.

oneOf.title: Toggle complaint-only mode
oneOf.description: Switches the till between normal selling and complaint-only mode. Aliases to ToggleComplaintOnlyCommand.

oneOf.title: Discount on line, percent
oneOf.description: Applies a percentage discount to the selected receipt line. Aliases to MarkDownPercentageKeyCommand. A receipt line must be selected.

oneOf.title: Discount on line, amount
oneOf.description: Applies an amount discount to the selected receipt line. Aliases to MarkDownAmountKeyCommand. A receipt line must be selected.

oneOf.title: Discount on whole order
oneOf.description: Applies a discount to the whole sale. Aliases to MarkDownOrderKeyCommand. An active transaction must exist.

oneOf.title: Remove discount from line
oneOf.description: Removes a discount from the selected receipt line. Aliases to RemoveOfferFromLineItemCommandChooser. A receipt line must be selected.

oneOf.title: Change price of line
oneOf.description: Overwrites the price of the selected receipt line. Aliases to PriceKeyCommand. A receipt line must be selected.

oneOf.title: Check a price
oneOf.description: Looks up an item's price without selling it. Aliases to PriceVerificationModeKeyCommand.

oneOf.title: Enter item package
oneOf.description: Starts grouping receipt lines into a package so they can be discounted together. Aliases to EnterItemPackageCommand. An active transaction must exist.

oneOf.title: Exit item package
oneOf.description: Finishes the item package and applies the chosen package discount. Aliases to ExitItemPackageCommand. An active transaction must exist.

oneOf.title: Add item to package
oneOf.description: Marks the selected line as part of the item package being built. Aliases to AddItemToPackageCommand. A receipt line must be selected.

oneOf.title: Redeem coupon
oneOf.description: Registers a coupon on the sale so promotions can apply. Aliases to RedeemCouponCommand.

oneOf.title: Discount code
oneOf.description: Attaches a promotion discount code to the sale. Aliases to DiscountCodeCommand. An active transaction must exist.

oneOf.title: Retrieve customer order
oneOf.description: Looks up a customer order and brings it onto the till. Aliases to RetrieveCustomerOrderCommand.

oneOf.title: Customer
oneOf.description: Registers a loyalty customer on the sale. Aliases to RegisterLoyaltyCustomerCommand. An active transaction must exist.

oneOf.title: Loyalty voucher
oneOf.description: Applies a loyalty voucher already available on the sale. Aliases to LoyaltyVoucherCommand. An active transaction must exist.

oneOf.title: Register external customer
oneOf.description: Registers an external or business customer on the sale. Aliases to ExternalCustomerRegistrationCommand. An active transaction must exist.

oneOf.title: Redeem loyalty points
oneOf.description: Registers a loyalty points scheme on the sale. Aliases to RedeemLoyaltyPointsCommand.

oneOf.title: Open cash drawer
oneOf.description: Opens the cash drawer with no sale. Aliases to NoSaleCommand.

oneOf.title: Paid in
oneOf.description: Records cash paid into the till. Aliases to PaidInCommand.

oneOf.title: Paid out
oneOf.description: Records cash taken out of the till. Aliases to PaidOutCommand.

oneOf.title: Tender pickup
oneOf.description: Removes cash from the till (tender pickup). Aliases to TenderPickupCommand.

oneOf.title: Tender loan
oneOf.description: Adds cash to the till (tender loan). Aliases to TenderLoanCommand.

oneOf.title: Finalize EPS sales period
oneOf.description: Closes the card terminal sales period. Aliases to EpsFinalizeSalesPeriodCommand.

oneOf.title: Gift card balance
oneOf.description: Checks the balance of a gift card. Aliases to GiftCardBalanceInquryCommand.

oneOf.title: Issue gift card
oneOf.description: Issues a new gift card. Aliases to IssueGiftCardCommand.

oneOf.title: Reload gift card
oneOf.description: Adds value to an existing gift card. Aliases to ReloadGiftCardCommand.

oneOf.title: Gift card cash out
oneOf.description: Withdraws the remaining balance from a gift card. Aliases to GiftCardCashOutCommand.

oneOf.title: Session activation
oneOf.description: Runs session start checks after sign-on. Not a typical sale button. Aliases to SessionActivationCommand.

oneOf.title: Show controlled prompt
oneOf.description: Shows a timed test prompt. Not intended for store use. Aliases to ShowControlledPromptCommand.

oneOf.title: Screen
oneOf.description: Opens a Checkout App screen.

oneOf.title: Return from a receipt
oneOf.description: Opens receipt search so the cashier can find a past sale and start a return. Opens the transactionSearch screen.

oneOf.title: Find a receipt
oneOf.description: Opens receipt search so the cashier can look up a past sale. Opens the transactionSearch screen.

oneOf.title: Business customer
oneOf.description: Opens business customer search to attach a B2B customer, project and agent to the sale. Opens the b2bCustomer screen.

oneOf.title: Find a customer order
oneOf.description: Opens customer order search so the cashier can find and retrieve an order. Opens the customerOrderSearch screen.

oneOf.title: Find an item
oneOf.description: Opens item search. Choosing a result adds it to the receipt. Opens the itemSearch screen.

oneOf.title: PLU menu
oneOf.description: Opens the PLU button menu. Choosing a PLU adds it to the receipt. Opens the plu screen.

oneOf.title: Web links
oneOf.description: Opens the store's configured web links. Opens the externalLinks screen.

oneOf.title: Tender
oneOf.description: Payment methods for the current sale.

oneOf.title: Cash
oneOf.description: Accepts cash payment. Aliases to TenderCashCommand. An active transaction must exist.

oneOf.title: Card
oneOf.description: Accepts card payment on the integrated payment terminal. Aliases to TenderUnifiedPaymentCommand. An active transaction must exist.

oneOf.title: Card, external terminal
oneOf.description: Records a card payment taken on a stand-alone terminal. Aliases to TenderStandAloneEftCommand. An active transaction must exist.

oneOf.title: Card, local terminal
oneOf.description: Accepts card payment on the local unified payment terminal. Aliases to TenderLocalUnifiedPaymentCommand. An active transaction must exist.

oneOf.title: Mobile payment
oneOf.description: Accepts a mobile wallet payment. Aliases to TenderMobilePaymentCommand. An active transaction must exist.

oneOf.title: Mobile payment, Vipps
oneOf.description: Accepts Vipps mobile payment. Aliases to TenderMobilePaymentMOVCommand. An active transaction must exist.

oneOf.title: Mobile payment, Svea
oneOf.description: Accepts Svea mobile payment. Aliases to TenderMobilePaymentMOACommand. An active transaction must exist.

oneOf.title: Gift card
oneOf.description: Pays with an electronic gift card. Aliases to TenderElectronicGiftCardCommand. An active transaction must exist.

oneOf.title: Gift certificate
oneOf.description: Pays with a gift certificate. Aliases to TenderGiftCertificateCommand. An active transaction must exist.

oneOf.title: Voucher
oneOf.description: Pays with a voucher. Aliases to TenderVoucherCommand. An active transaction must exist.

oneOf.title: Coupon
oneOf.description: Pays with a coupon as tender, not as a promotion. Aliases to TenderCouponCommand. An active transaction must exist.

oneOf.title: Invoice to organisation
oneOf.description: Charges the sale to the organisation already on the receipt. Aliases to TenderOrganizationChargeCommandCust. An active transaction must exist.

oneOf.title: Invoice to organisation (standard)
oneOf.description: Charges the sale to an organisation account using the store default type. Aliases to TenderOrganizationChargeCommand. An active transaction must exist.

oneOf.title: Invoice to organisation (external customer)
oneOf.description: Charges the sale to an external organisation customer on the receipt. Aliases to TenderOrganizationChargeCommandExtCust.

oneOf.title: Invoice to organisation (B2B)
oneOf.description: Charges the sale to the B2B customer on the receipt. Aliases to TenderOrganizationChargeCommandB2bCust.

oneOf.title: Loyalty points
oneOf.description: Pays with loyalty points. Aliases to TenderLoyaltyRedemptionCommand. An active transaction must exist.

oneOf.title: Check
oneOf.description: Pays by check. Aliases to TenderCheckCommand. An active transaction must exist.

oneOf.title: House account
oneOf.description: Charges the sale to a house account. Aliases to TenderHouseAccountCommand.

oneOf.title: Card, EPS
oneOf.description: Accepts card payment through the classic EPS terminal. Aliases to TenderEftCommand.

oneOf.title: Card, EPS (select subtype)
oneOf.description: Accepts card payment through EPS after the cashier chooses the card type. Aliases to TenderEftSelectCommand.

oneOf.title: E-gift card UGCP
oneOf.description: Pays with an electronic gift card (UGCP). Aliases to TenderElectronicGiftCardUGCPCommand. An active transaction must exist.

oneOf.title: E-gift card UGCV
oneOf.description: Pays with an electronic gift card (UGCV). Aliases to TenderElectronicGiftCardUGCVCommand.

oneOf.title: Pseudo tender
oneOf.description: Registers a preconfigured pseudo tender, not a payment of the amount due. Aliases to PreSelectedPseudoTenderCommand1. An active transaction must exist.

oneOf.title: Bottle deposit
oneOf.description: Registers a bottle deposit return with a preset deposit item. Aliases to PreSelectedRedeemBottleDepositCommand. An active transaction must exist.

oneOf.title: Food stamp
oneOf.description: Pays with food stamps. Aliases to TenderFoodStampCommand. An active transaction must exist.

oneOf.title: Damaged bill
oneOf.description: Accepts cash as a damaged banknote. Aliases to DamagedBillTenderCashCommand. An active transaction must exist.

command.title: Command
command.description: The Checkout Engine command name, for example SuspendOrderCommand.

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.description: List of conditions that should be fulfilled at the client if the choice is selected. A good behaving client prevents selection of choices that doesn't fulfill the conditions.

Color.title: Color
Color.description: Background color of the button. Default is the store theme. The till picks black or white text to stay readable. Inapplicable to root groups.

id.title: Id
id.description: A unique identifier for the Menu item.

deleted.title: Deleted
deleted.description: If true, this Menu item will not be available

sequenceNumber.title: Sequence number
sequenceNumber.description: A sequence number to sort items.

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of the Menu item.

size.title: Size
size.description: Grid span. Wide takes two columns, tall two rows, large both.

MenuGroup.title: Menu group
MenuGroup.description: This is a Menu - it contains a set of other Menus to form a hierarchy.

id.title: Id
id.description: A unique identifier for the Menu group.

deleted.title: Deleted
deleted.description: If true, this Menu group will not be available

sequenceNumber.title: Sequence number
sequenceNumber.description: A sequence number to sort items.

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: The icon URI. Inapplicable to root groups.

type.title: Type
type.description: The GROUP type is for Menu lists.

content.description: Menu lists can contain other Menu lists and/or items.

MenuContentItem.title: Menu content item.
MenuContentItem.description: Each item in a menu list can be a menu item or a menu group.

MenuListType.title: Menu list
MenuListType.description: A menu tree. Type defines where in the app the list is displayed.

id.title: Id
id.description: A unique identifier for the Menu.

deleted.title: Deleted
deleted.description: If true, this Menu list will not be available

type.title: List type
type.description: Where in the app the given list is displayed.

oneOf.title: Default
oneOf.description: Rendered in the main menu component. Not applicable for Self checkout application type.

oneOf.title: Payment
oneOf.description: Payment options menu. Rendered in dedicated payment menu component.

oneOf.title: Item
oneOf.description: Item context menu when an item is manually selected. Available for smaller devices only (Mobile POS).

applicationType.title: Application type
applicationType.description: The application type required to access the Menu list.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: The checkout engine mode required to access the Menu list. This menu is shown when the till is in this mode.

oneOf.title: None (default)
oneOf.description: Normal checkout. Scans and keys add items to the sale.

oneOf.title: Till audit
oneOf.description: The cashier is counting the till against expected amounts.

oneOf.title: Item package
oneOf.description: The cashier is grouping receipt lines into a package to discount them together.

oneOf.title: Petty cash
oneOf.description: The cashier is adding or removing till float (petty cash handling).

oneOf.title: Post void
oneOf.description: The cashier is voiding a completed receipt.

oneOf.title: Preview customer order
oneOf.description: The cashier is previewing a customer order before bringing it onto the till.

oneOf.title: Price verification
oneOf.description: The cashier is looking up an item's price without selling it.

oneOf.title: Refund
oneOf.description: The next item scanned is treated as a refund, not a sale.

oneOf.title: Refund previous order
oneOf.description: The cashier is refunding lines from a previous receipt.

oneOf.title: Spot balance
oneOf.description: The cashier is doing a quick till count, not a full audit.

oneOf.title: Void
oneOf.description: The next scan or key voids a line on the current sale.
